author: Florence Kyei
title: Who Pays When the Applause Stops? Visibility, Power and Ghana’s Black Challenge
content:
The Black Challenge has won African titles, an African Para Games gold medal and a place at the 2026 Amputee Football World Cup. Yet weeks before leaving for Mexico, where they will face Angola, Colombia and Iraq in Group D, Ghana’s national amputee football team is still appealing for financial support.


This is the paradox at the heart of Ghanaian para-football: a team successful enough to bring international recognition and national pride, but not yet supported by a sporting system strong enough to make that success sustainable.


The appeal came at

the team’s unveiling in Accra on September 28

, where the president of the National Paralympic Committee Ghana (NPC-Ghana), Samson Deen, called on the government to settle outstanding bonuses and per diems and allocate at least 5% of the Black Stars budget to amputee football.


At the same event,

NPC-Ghana announced bonuses of GH¢10,000 for each player and GH¢5,000 for each official

 under its “Target the Podium” initiative.


Deen also said the Black Challenge “deserves everything that sports winners win for the nation.”


The issue predates the current World Cup campaign. In May 2024, captain Richard Arthur Opentil

publicly raised concerns about outstanding bonuses and inadequate support

 while the team competed at the Amputee Africa Cup of Nations in Cairo.


In a phone interview on October 17, 2026, Opentil said the two winning bonuses remained outstanding: one for the Para Games and another for the Africa Cup of Nations in Egypt. “We have two outstanding bonuses to collect from the government,” he said. He added: “I think when you win, the state needs to reward you.”


When asked if visibility has brought the team any form of support, he offered a qualified answer. “Financial wise, yes and no… We’ve been partially rewarded, but not fully,” he said.


At the Black Challenge’s unveiling ahead of the 2026 World Cup, Minister of Sports and Recreation Kofi Adams said he

has asked the team’s leaders to submit documentation

 so that the government could follow up on pledges and promises “that have been made verbally.”


The event also brought some financial commitments. According to

Modern Ghana

, Gold Fields Ghana pledged US$500,000 in support of disability sport, with US$250,000 earmarked for the group’s World Cup preparations.


On May 8, 2026, Gold Fields Ghana and the Ghana Football Association (GFA) announced a two-year partnership worth US$5 million. The agreement covers the Black Stars, Black Queens, Women’s Premier League and Black Challenge. According to the

GFA announcement

, the partnership is expected to promote “inclusivity through dedicated support for the Black Challenge”, but it does not specify how much funding the team would receive.


Reports of the September unveiling do not explain how the US$500,000 pledged relates to the wider US$5 million partnership.


In a phone interview on October 20, the Secretary-General of the National Amputee Football Association of Ghana, Mohammed Harmis Muzair, explained that there was an understanding that the Black Challenge would receive US$500,000 from the wider partnership. Because the team was not directly involved in negotiating the sponsorship, requests for funding had to go through the GFA, which would review its proposals before forwarding them to KPMG, which Muzair described as the administrator of the funds.


“As we have been talking, we have not received even a dime from the money yet,” Muzair said. He added that the GFA had provided footballs, training jerseys and other clothing, while efforts were ongoing to make funds available for the team’s expenses.


Opentil also explained that although Gold Fields Ghana had made a provision towards the team’s preparations, the team’s administrators were writing formally to request the funds. “[Gold Fields] has made a provision for us, but you know it is a process and you need to write to them for them to pay the money… Our administrators are formally writing.”


At community level, the gap between policy commitments and sporting opportunities remains a concern.

Research on disability sport in Ghana

 identifies inadequate funding, limited access to appropriate training facilities and equipment, and weaknesses in the implementation of inclusion policies.


Para-athletes can find themselves training on rough dirt pitches, open school fields and improvised spaces that are not designed with disabled athletes in mind.

author: David Swanson
title: Keep on Moving Forward
content:
By Kathy Kelly, World BEYOND War, November 5, 2026


Hopefully, collective voices will continue mobilizing to abolish war and sustain life.


On November 3, 2026, U.S. voters sent an intensely needed message to Republicans as well as the Democratic status quo in the United States. Voters insisted on concrete steps to cope with the greatest threats afflicting people worldwide, –nuclear weapon proliferation, ecological collapse, and complicity with genocide.


Three weeks earlier, the 

Illinois chapter of 

World BEYOND War

 hosted a Young Voters Congress, a hybrid forum inviting attendees to air their views about which issues would most affect their choices in upcoming elections. Spoken word poet 

Trey Baker

 opened the event by pointing to cruel roots of racism, militarism, and unbridled greed, but he believes a better world is still possible.


Kayla Pilgrim

, Communications Lead for 

Sunrise Movement Chicago

, was the keynote speaker. Profound concern for two younger sisters affected by asthma had motivated Kayla to tackle issues related to poisoned environments. At age 20, she has learned to connect the dots. She called on the assembled group to join her in overcoming fears by forming community and becoming active.


“We are here to first crush fascism,” Kayla stated. She decried abuses of the military-industrial-media-congressional complex and urged the DNC to stop funding genocide and instead fund efforts to avoid ecological collapse. Kayla noted that the Sunrise Movement in Chicago had recently occupied local 

AIPAC

 offices to protest support for candidates tolerating Israel’s genocide against Palestinians. She also issued a call for Illinois residents to oust ICE for good.


A panel entitled “Militarism, Racism, Inequality and Climate Collapse: The Tentacles of the War Machine,” moderated by 

CODEPINK’s Danaka Katovich

, featured 

Tree Palmeras, Director of 

Black Lives Matter, Chicago

,

 and 

Henna Ayesh

 from the DePaul University 2024 encampment for Palestine. They covered issues ranging from motivation for activism to the repugnance of paying taxes to kill children at home and abroad.


Henna Ayesh noted the irony of the United States, on land stolen from Indigenous peoples, provisioning weapons and surveillance capacities to Israel for use in perpetrating Israeli genocide against Palestinians.


Panelist Tree Palmeras said Haitian family members encouraged her, as a child, to resist militarism. She decried the violence that decimates communities whether perpetrated by U.S. wars abroad, or though heavily militarized policing and incarceration in U.S. cities.


Danaka Katovich (

CODEPINK

), called on participants to resist the NDAA (National Defense Authorization Act) 1033 program, which donates surplus U.S. Department of War weapons to U.S. police departments.


The day after the midterm elections, 

Melissa Garigga

, one of Danaka’s colleagues at CODE PINK asked why the U.S. taxpayers should give “the very people voters rejected an unprecedented $1.5 trillion budget to continue their reign of death and destruction? Why are we going to allow Congress to hand over the largest war budget in human history to weapons manufacturers and AI tech billionaires who work at the behest of known war criminals?”


Hopefully, this piercing question along with all the themes raised at the Young Voters’ Congress will convince activists to remain in the streets, stay vigilant, and follow the young people. Let the votes that demanded change be just the beginning.


~~~~~~~~


Kathy Kelly, (

kathy.vcnv@gmail.com

), syndicated by 

PeaceVoice

, is Board President of 

World BEYOND War.

 


The post

Keep on Moving Forward

 appeared first on

World BEYOND War

.

author: Gustavo Faleiros
title: A desinformação da extrema direita sobre queimadas
content:
Quer receber os textos desta coluna em primeira mão no seu e-mail? Assine a newsletter Ligando os pontos, enviada toda quinta-feira. Para receber as próximas edições,

inscreva-se aqui

.


Durante a campanha eleitoral do segundo turno, duas proeminentes vozes da extrema direita, o deputado Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) e o governador de São Paulo,

Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos-SP)

, difundiram deliberadamente desinformação sobre os incêndios florestais na Amazônia.


Enquanto a população de Manaus sofria com a má qualidade do ar, que levou ao cancelamento de aulas em escolas e universidades, os dois políticos, acompanhados por influenciadores bolsonaristas, produziram vídeos com informações falsas em busca de ganhos eleitorais para Flávio Bolsonaro.


Talvez bebendo na experiência do vídeo fabricado no Nordeste por Nikolas, o governador de São Paulo entrou no campo da produção fraudulenta de conteúdo. Acusou o governo federal de negar apoio ao governo do Amazonas no combate aos incêndios, o que foi

desmentido pela administração estadual

. E até o que se pretendia real – o envio de bombeiros paulistas para apoiar o combate às chamas – se revelou uma farsa.


De maneira a confundir as audiências das redes sociais, os vídeos da extrema direita tratavam queimadas e desmatamento como a mesma coisa. A questão que levantavam era: como poderia o Ministério do Meio Ambiente apresentar dados com as taxas de desmatamento mais baixas da história se estávamos vendo enormes nuvens de fumaça saindo da floresta? O objetivo era questionar a efetividade da política e combate ao desmatamento do governo Lula.


A desinformação de Nikolas e Tarcísio veio à tona porque as queimadas no Amazonas não indicam que o desmatamento está fora do controle. É exatamente o contrário. Nos últimos anos, as tendências são inversas: queimadas em alta e desmatamento em baixa. Se olharmos a taxa de desmatamento na Amazônia de 2024, vemos que ela foi reduzida mesmo sendo um ano de queimadas recordes.


Aquele ano, como este, foi afetado pelo El Niño, fenômeno climático que causa mais seca na região Norte. É provável que neste final de ano grandes incêndios ocorram sem que represente mais desmatamento. Isto é especialmente verdade no momento em que a seca na Amazônia se acentua a cada dia.


Uma informação bastante preocupante divulgada pelo

Boletim de Monitoramento Ambiental da Amazônia

, iniciativa da Organização do Tratado de Cooperação Amazônica (OTCA), indicou que, em setembro de 2026, as chuvas nas bacias dos principais rios amazônicos ficaram 69% abaixo da média histórica.


/Temos sim um grave problema com as queimadas na floresta, sejam elas causadas pela situação climática ou pelos criminosos ambientais. Há um impacto na saúde da população e muitas cidades da Amazônia e do Cerrado devem ser afetadas ainda este ano. Mas há também o fato de que, com mais queimadas, a mudança climática está sendo exacerbada. Mais biomassa em chamas significa mais emissões de carbono.


Círculo vicioso


A bióloga Erika Berenguer, pesquisadora da Universidade de Lancaster, no Reino Unido, estuda há anos a situação das queimadas na Floresta Nacional do Tapajós, onde agora também os focos de calor começaram a aparecer. Ela tem demonstrado através de suas pesquisas que, com o aumento da frequência dos eventos extremos climáticos, a floresta se torna cada vez mais suscetível ao fogo. É um círculo vicioso: com mais calor, mais vulnerável se torna a Amazônia.


Em um vídeo publicado no LinkedIn

, Berenger explicou muito bem a diferença do que se considera o desmatamento a corte raso, aquele feito para abrir clareiras em meio à floresta, e as queimadas que atingem a vegetação por baixo das copas ou usadas para a limpeza de pastagens. Seu recado é claro: sem enfrentar as mudanças climáticas, o fogo será cada vez mais comum.


Já as queimadas associadas a atividades ilegais de desmatamento e grilagem precisam ser investigadas, como no caso dos incêndios recentes do Amazonas. Não podemos esquecer que uma das séries de queimadas mais intensas, a de 2019, no primeiro ano de governo de Jair Bolsonaro, foi sim causada por um esforço coordenado e criminoso de desmatamento no período da seca. Assim, ao mesmo tempo em que as reduções de emissões de gases estufa terão que ocorrer, o combate ao crime ambiental deve seguir como prioridade.


Outra questão que a ser colocada é que o combate às queimadas e a autorização para as queimas controladas, assim como o que ocorre com a …

author: CMI Argentina
title: Industria: 108 mil puestos perdidos y 4400 empresas menos desde que gobierna Milei
content:
El presidente de Industriales Pymes Argentinos (IPA), Daniel Rosato, alertó sobre el deterioro de la actividad industrial, marcado por el cierre de empresas, la pérdida de puestos de trabajo y la caída de la producción. Según el último informe del Observatorio IPA, la industria manufacturera perdió 108.522 empleos formales desde diciembre de 2023 y registra más de 4.400 empleadores manufactureros menos. Además, el 57% de esa reducción se concentró en el último año.


Rosato advirtió que la situación del sector continúa agravándose y que las dificultades para sostener la actividad se profundizan en un contexto de caída del mercado interno y falta de financiamiento.


“Desde diciembre de 2023 hemos perdido 108 mil puestos de trabajo industriales y se registró una reducción de 4.424 empleadores manufactureros”, afirmó el dirigente. Y agregó que más de la mitad de la caída de empleadores se produjo durante el último año, lo que evidencia, una aceleración del deterioro de la estructura productiva.


El informe de la entidad también indica que el 41,5% de la capacidad industrial permanece ociosa y que 12 de las 16 ramas manufactureras acumulan caídas en sus niveles de producción. “No podemos hablar de una recuperación económica mientras la industria sigue perdiendo empleadores, trabajadores y capacidad productiva”, sostuvo Rosato.


En ese marco, reclamó medidas para recuperar el mercado interno, facilitar el acceso al financiamiento y sostener a las pequeñas y medianas empresas. También advirtió sobre las dificultades que tendrán las industrias para afrontar el pago de aguinaldos a fin de año, en un escenario de profundización de la caída del consumo y la actividad.


Desde Industriales Pymes Argentinos sostienen que el alivio fiscal debe complementarse con políticas de financiamiento productivo y medidas que impulsen la recuperación del mercado interno. “La prioridad tiene que ser sostener a las empresas que producen y generan trabajo. Porque cuando una industria deja de funcionar, recuperar esa capacidad productiva es mucho más difícil”, concluyó Rosato.El presidente de Industriales Pymes Argentinos (IPA), Daniel Rosato, alertó sobre el deterioro de la actividad industrial, marcado por el cierre de empresas, la pérdida de puestos de trabajo y la caída de la producción. Según el último informe del Observatorio IPA, la industria manufacturera perdió 108.522 empleos formales desde diciembre de 2023 y registra más de 4.400 empleadores manufactureros menos. Además, el 57% de esa reducción se concentró en el último año.

author: David Swanson
title: We Can Save Ourselves
content:
By Peter Kuznick and Ivana Nikolić Hughes, World BEYOND War, November 5, 2026


The 1984 British movie

Threads

 opens with ordinary scenes in Sheffield, England, where a young couple learns they are expecting a baby. The story of their personal life is intertwined with the news of a growing conflict between the United States and the Soviet Union, centered on Iran. We next learn that a nuclear weapon is used in an attack, followed by another. Before long, Sheffield itself is the site of hydrogen bomb detonations, with our protagonists either perishing in the explosions or subsisting under devastating conditions of starvation, civil unrest, radiation-induced and infectious diseases, and freezing temperatures over the coming days, weeks, months, and years. The film ends with the 13-year-old daughter of the young couple from the start of the film giving birth to a deformed clump of flesh months after being raped in a lawless and collapsed society.


Forty-two years after this brilliant movie first gave people in the UK and beyond just a glimpse of the unfathomable consequences of nuclear war, watching the opening scenes is even more grim than it has been in the intervening decades, given just how eerily similar they seem to be to our current moment. With

the US and Israel continuing to wage war on Iran

, and their respective leaders having been repudiated in

public polls

 and

elections

, the prospect of nuclear weapon use and a wider nuclear war is seemingly more real than ever before. But unlike in the 1980s, when the

general public was well aware

 of what was at stake, having been frightened by Ronald Reagan’s saber-rattling and educated about the dangers of nuclear weapons throughout the Cold War, including through cultural interventions like popular films, today, when President Trump repeatedly

threatens to annihilate Iran

, the media and the general public seem to shrug and move on to other news of the day, checking perhaps on what Kim Kardashian had for breakfast.


The seriousness of Trump’s threats cannot be overstated. The two of us have been warning in

Al

Jazeera

 and

other outlets

 that, sick and desperate as such threats might be, it behooves the world to take them seriously and make sure a nuclear attack on Iran, or anywhere else for that matter, never happens. Recently, we have been joined by popular media figure

Tucker Carlson

 and other commentators. The internet is abuzz with such warnings.


The logic is simple. Trump and Netanyahu are both desperate to salvage what little credibility they may have with their publics by demonstrating that this war with Iran was not a total failure. If the purpose of the war had been to prevent Iran from acquiring a nuclear weapon or weapons, then having Iran acquire a nuclear weapon or weapons would be the ultimate repudiation of their efforts and proof of their folly.


Both US and Israeli intelligence agencies report that Iran has shifted the locus of its nuclear enrichment from Fordow and Natanz to the Kuh-e Kolang underground complex widely known as

Pickaxe Mountain

. The complex is buried under 300 feet of granite, which makes it impenetrable for U.S. or Israeli conventional weapons, including the Mother of All Bombs (MOAB), which Trump has threatened to use. Tucker Carlson shared that he had an “informed source” who told him, “Bibi calls Trump about it [a nuclear strike] every day.” Fortunately, Trump has not yet given the go-ahead.


The background to all this is that Iran has made clear that it will neither export its enriched uranium or cease its enrichment activities, both of which it had done before Trump stupidly blew up Obama’s Iran nuclear deal or

JCPOA

. With the deal in place, Iran had also mothballed most of its centrifuges and, according to the UN’s International Atomic Energy Agency inspectors, was only

enriching to 3.67 percent

—well below weapons grade. Ayatollah Khamenei had issued a

fatwa

 against building an Iranian nuclear weapon, which remained in effect until he and other Iranian leaders were

killed

 in a joint U.S./Israeli strike back in February. Now numerous Iranian leaders have publicly insisted that Iran needs a nuclear weapon as a deterrent against another U.S. and/or Israeli attack. There is evidence that some leaders of the

IRGC

 have also adopted this view despite the fact that official Iranian government policy continues to reject such actions.

author: CMI Argentina
title: Juicio a Molinos: un expolicía reveló cómo funcionaba la vigilancia interna de los trabajadores
content:
Tres extrabajadores de Molinos Río de la Plata declararon en el juicio contra el exjefe de Personal Emilio Parodi por el secuestro y desaparición de tres obreros durante la última dictadura. Entre ellos, un policía retirado de la Federal que trabajó en el grupo de vigilancia e inteligencia de la empresa y que declaró en otros juicios de lesa humanidad, entre ellos el Juicio a las Juntas. Su testimonio puso el foco en los vínculos entre la compañía y las fuerzas represivas.


Redacción: Ailín Bullentini (para la cobertura especial de La Retaguardia y Pulso Noticias)


El personal de vigilancia y Bomberos de Molinos Río de la Plata tenía un “control absoluto sobre los trabajadores”. No solamente sobre sus tareas, sino también sobre sus reuniones, sus conversaciones y sus actividades políticas. La información que recogían era transmitida a la oficina de Personal de la empresa. Así lo aseguró Armando Luchina, un policía retirado de la Federal que trabajó en la planta que la alimenticia tenía en Avellaneda entre 1980 y 1987 y que este martes declaró en el juicio por la responsabilidad del exjefe de Personal Emilio Parodi en el secuestro y desaparición de tres obreros durante la última dictadura.


Luchina fue uno de los tres extrabajadores de la alimenticia que prestaron testimonio el martes 27 de octubre ante el Tribunal Oral Federal 2 de La Plata. Los otros dos, Carlos Pérez y Eduardo Carunchio, habían sido operarios de la fábrica durante la primera mitad de la década de 1970.


La persecución obrera y las responsabilidades empresariales


Los tres testimonios aportaron perspectivas diferentes sobre el funcionamiento de Molinos Río de la Plata durante los años de mayor conflictividad sindical y represión política. Pérez y Carunchio describieron una planta atravesada por los reclamos salariales, la organización de los trabajadores y las intervenciones de una jefatura de Personal que, según sus relatos, ejercía un fuerte poder disciplinador.


Luchina, por su parte, aportó información sobre el funcionamiento posterior del área de Vigilancia y Bomberos, el control de las actividades políticas y gremiales y los vínculos que, según afirmó, existían entre la empresa y las fuerzas policiales.


Esos relatos se incorporaron al debate en el que la Justicia busca establecer la responsabilidad penal de Parodi, en calidad de coautor, de las privaciones ilegales de la libertad de

Francisco Fernández, Santos Ojeda y Roberto José Rivolta Bonino

, secuestrados el 7 de julio de 1976 en la planta de Avellaneda o en sus accesos. Los tres continúan desaparecidos. La acusación sostiene que el exjefe de Personal participó en la identificación y entrega de trabajadores a las fuerzas represivas.


Aunque la investigación más amplia sobre la represión en Molinos abarca casi tres decenas de trabajadores víctimas del terrorismo de Estado, este juicio está concentrado en los tres secuestros ocurridos el 7 de julio de 1976. Los testimonios de quienes compartieron la vida cotidiana de la fábrica permiten reconstruir las condiciones en las que se produjeron esos crímenes y el funcionamiento de los mecanismos de vigilancia y persecución que los precedieron.


Un expolicía en el cuerpo de Bomberos de Molinos


La declaración de Armando Luchina tuvo una particularidad: no era la primera vez que se presentaba ante la Justicia para aportar información sobre los crímenes de la última dictadura. Ya había declarado como testigo en el histórico Juicio a las Juntas de 1985 y también en el juicio por la Masacre de Fátima.


Luchina integró la Policía Federal Argentina desde 1971 hasta 1980. Según relató, había trabajado en el área que la fuerza denominó “antisubversiva” de la Superintendencia de Seguridad Federal ―que durante la última dictadura fue un centro clandestino de detención, tortura y exterminio―. Cuando quedó en situación de disponibilidad ―lo desplazaron―, buscó otro empleo y respondió a un aviso publicado en el diario Clarín. Así llegó a Molinos Río de la Plata.


Ingresó en 1980 y permaneció hasta 1987, cuando, según explicó, una resolución judicial permitió su reincorporación a la fuerza. Durante esos siete años trabajó en el sector de Vigilancia y Bomberos de la planta de Avellaneda, aunque también realizaba controles en distintos depósitos de la compañía.


Su pasado policial, consideró, fue determinante para conseguir el puesto. Durante la entrevista de ingreso, una persona a la que identificó como San Juan le preguntó por su experiencia …

title: La CNT exige dignidad en el SPIF y presenta una tabla de demandas laborales para el personal de extinción de incendios

Leer en

La CNT exige dignidad en el SPIF y presenta una tabla de demandas laborales para el personal de extinción de incendios


El sindicato exige medidas urgentes como un aumento salarial ante la pérdida de poder adquisitivo, el pago de dietas y la mejora sustancial de los equipos de protección y las condiciones de habitabilidad de los lugares de trabajo.


La sección sindical de la CNT en el SPIF acaba de lanzar la campaña «

Dignidad en el SPIF

» con el objetivo de denunciar la precariedad del Servicio de Prevención y Defensa contra Incendios Forestales (SPIF) y exigir mejoras inmediatas en las condiciones laborales y de seguridad del personal.


La organización sindical subraya que los trabajadores que combaten incendios en la sierra gallega se enfrentan constantemente a situaciones de riesgo extremo sin el reconocimiento ni los recursos materiales adecuados. Por ello, la CNT articula sus reivindicaciones en torno a cinco pilares fundamentales:


Aumento salarial:

 Exigimos la asignación de niveles salariales más altos y un complemento específico que nos permita frenar y reducir la continua pérdida de poder adquisitivo que sufre el colectivo. Basta de trabajar por salarios de miseria.


Pago de dietas:

 Reconocimiento y pago efectivo de la compensación por mantenimiento.


Mejora de las condiciones en los puestos de trabajo:

 Adaptación y mantenimiento óptimo de las instalaciones y bases donde el personal realiza sus turnos y jornadas laborales. Exigimos dignidad e instalaciones adecuadas para las personas; no somos animales. Mejora de los EPI: Suministro de EPI modernos y adaptados al peligro real de los incendios forestales para garantizar la salud y la seguridad física del personal. No queremos seguir trabajando con equipos obsoletos que ponen en riesgo nuestras vidas.


Criterios comunes y transparentes:

 Establecimiento de un marco normativo homogéneo y equitativo para regular las asignaciones y comisiones de servicio, poniendo fin a cualquier tipo de arbitrariedad. Se acabó el nepotismo y el pago de favores.


Defender la sierra gallega implica, de forma innegociable, dignificar las condiciones del personal que arriesga su vida en primera línea contra el fuego. Desde la CNT hacemos un llamamiento a la organización y movilización de todo el personal del SPIF para presionar a la administración a fin de que abra un canal real para solucionar las terribles condiciones del sector.


Galego

A CNT esixe Dignidade no SPIF e presenta unha táboa de reivindicacións laborais para o persoal contra incendio


O sindicato reclama medidas urxentes como a suba salarial fronte á perda de poder adquisitivo, o abono de dietas e a mellora substancial dos equipamentos de protección e da habitabilidade dos centros de traballo.


A sección sindical da CNT no SPIF vén de lanzar a campaña

«Dignidade no SPIF»

A organización sindical subliña que as traballadoras e traballadores que combaten o lume nos montes galegos enfróntanse acotío a situacións de extremo risco sen contar co recoñecemento nin cos recursos materiais axeitados. Por este motivo, a CNT articula as súas esixencias en torno a cinco piares fundamentais:


Suba salarial:

 Demandamos a asignación de niveis de destino e complemento específico máis altos que permitan frear e reducir a perda continuada de poder adquisitivo que arrastra o colectivo. Non máis traballo por soldos de miseria.


Pagamento de dietas:

 O recoñecemento e aboamento efectivo das compensacións por manutención.


Mellora das condicións nos centros de traballo:

 Adecuación e mantemento óptimo das instalacións e bases onde o persoal desenvolve as súas gardas e xornadas de traballo. Demandamos dignidade e instalacións acondicionadas para persoas, non somos animais.

 Dotación de Equipamentos de Protección Individual modernos e adaptados á perigosidade real dos incendios forestais para garantir a saúde e seguridade física dos efectivos. Non queremos seguir traballando con equipos obsoletos que poñen en risco a nosa vida.

author: Miriam Lafontaine
title: NTI looking for two vice-presidents in Dec. 14 election
content:
Nunavut Tunngavik Inc. and the territory’s three regional Inuit associations are holding elections to fill a variety of leadership positions.


The nomination period for those hoping to fill two vice-presidential roles up for grabs at NTI opened Monday and will close on Friday.


The two vice-president positions appears to be a change from the organization’s current structure.


Paul Irngaut is currently the NTI vice-president but going back to 2010, NTI

held elections

 for two vice-president positions, with one winner becoming chair of social development and the other chair of the organization’s wildlife advisory council.


Nunatsiaq News has reached out to NTI to ask whether there are any differences between the two vice-presidential roles up for grabs in this year’s election.


Nunavut Tunngavik Inc. is the organization responsible for making sure the promises in the Nunavut Agreement are met.


Nunavut’s three regional organizations are also holding elections Dec. 14.


The Kitikmeot Inuit Association is seeking a new president. The nomination period opened Oct. 23 and closes Friday.


The Qikiqtani Inuit Association is

holding an election

 for president as well, and community directors for Iqaluit, Igloolik, Kimmirut, Sanirajak, Clyde River, Pond Inlet and Sanikiluaq. The nomination period opens Nov. 9 and runs until Nov. 13.


And the Kivalliq Inuit Association is

searching for people

 to fill five seats on its board of directors. They include a vice-president, secretary/treasurer, and community director positions in Naujaat, Whale Cove and Rankin Inlet.


The nomination period opened for that election on Oct. 26 and closes Nov. 9.

author: CNT Aranjuez
title: AlTajo 88 Noviembre 2026
content:
AlTajo88Nov2026

Descarga


Buenas compas!


Como cada mes, os hacemos llegar la revista ALTAJO, órgano de expresión de la CNT de Aranjuez. En vuestra bandeja de entrada o en la web de CNT Aranjuez os encontraréis los anteriores 87 números de esta revista, ya que hoy, presentamos el número 88 del mes de noviembre de 2026.


Un mes en el que hay convocada una huelga general el miércoles 11, además de haber varias huelgas sectoriales activas, de las cuales resaltamos aquellas en las que participamos desde CNT Aranjuez, ya sea apoyando, como es el caso de la huelga de Educación Infantil en la Comunidad de Madrid (7 meses de huelga), y convocando, como es el caso de la huelga docente de Educación Pública de la Comunidad de Madrid (un mes de huelga en todas las etapas). En nuestra sección SINDICALISMO, como no podía ser de otra manera, encontraréis artículos sobre las dos huelgas docentes.


Abriendo nuestra revista este mes, en la sección A VOCES, recogemos el Manifiesto Confederal para el 11N, también una reflexión y alegato a la huelga, de Yanis Merinkis, y cierra esta sección Azucena Arráns denunciando las restricciones en la frontera de Kerem Abu Salem que amenaza con la hambruna nuevamente al pueblo gazatí.


En la sección CULTURA LIBRE, dos colaboraciones de la Asociación Cultural La Casa Negra para hablarnos de Memoria histórica y de historias ocurridas en Aranjuez «el verano que acabó con la primavera». Los Archiveros del Real Sitio de Lizania continúan su estudio de la obra del gran poeta anarquista y nos presentan su artículo «Lorca en Lizano». Cerrando la sección, Fernando Barbero aporta luz sobre la figura de Teresa Claramunt Creus en una nueva entrega de «Mujeres anarquistas abriendo huella.»


Nuestra sección PIENSO LUEGO EXISTO recoge una nueva reflexión y denuncia de Yanis Merinakis sobre las actitudes autoritarias dentro de organizaciones libertarias. Hablamos también de nuestro BiciTaller Colaborativo que sigue cada mes funcionando (y podéis sumaros si aún no tuvisteis oportunidad). También en esta sección encontramos un nuevo relato de Sotiris Dimitriu traducido por Yanis Merinakis. Domingo Martínez nos aporta dos nuevas reseñas de libros, ambas editadas por la Fundación Anselmo Lorenzo (FAL). Recogemos el catálogo de ediciones de FAL Aranjuez y por último las próximas convocatorias a la que esperamos podáis asistir.


Deseamos que os resulte enriquecedor y estimulante este nuevo número 88 de la revista ALTAJO y os animamos a participar en este proyecto colectivo.

Salud y acierto!

 se publicó primero en

Confederación Nacional del Trabajo

author: webdev@democracynow.org (Democracy Now!)
title: "They Have Eyes": How Trump's Corruption Became a Top Concern for Midterm Voters
content:
Democrats regained control of both the House and the Senate in Tuesday’s historic midterm elections, a comeback fueled largely by voter anger over high prices and the war on Iran. But surveys also found that corruption was a major concern, with 76% of voters telling a Harris poll that elected officials care more about enriching themselves than improving the economy for ordinary people. A separate Reuters/Ipsos poll found that 63% of Americans considered it inappropriate for Trump and his family to profit from cryptocurrency, while 69% said his private business interests influence his decisions as president.


“If this election was about corruption and cost, then this next Congress needs to be focused on accountability and affordability,” says Donald Sherman, the president and

CEO

 of Citizens for Responsibility and Ethics in Washington, or

CREW

.


“Congress needs to do oversight not just on the administration’s corruption, not just on the president’s profiteering, but also on corporate America, what they have gotten out of engaging in the president’s pay-to-play environment, how corporate America and the outside influence of money in our political system has undermined the public voice in our policy discussions.”

title: Assemblea di Ateneo a Pisa il 9/11 ore 11:30
content:
I costi della vita aumentano, la benzina e i trasporti anche. Intanto, il governo pensa solo ad aumentare la spesa militare, peggiorando la situazione in cui ci troviamo. E così vengono sacrificati i servizi pubblici e tagliati i fondi all’istruzione e all’università.


Il 9 novembre ci troviamo in assemblea d’ateneo: adesso decidiamo noi!


L’assemblea d’ateneo è un’occasione rarissima in università, perché a noi studenti non vengono mai concessi gli spazi per discutere e decidere insieme. Con le mobilitazioni di queste settimane e l’occupazione di Palazzo della Sapienza, abbiamo ottenuto una prima vittoria: quattro ore di sospensione didattica per tutti, per poter partecipare liberamente. Quest’assemblea sarà un primo momento per incontrarci tutt insieme e organizzarci sulla nostra vita. Se l’Università, il DSU e le altre istituzioni non si prendono le proprie responsabilità, dobbiamo essere noi a pretenderlo. Ci servono più appelli, l’estensione del contributo affitto, l’abbassamento dei prezzi della mensa, non stiamo mica chiedendo la luna! Come ci organizziamo per ottenerlo?


Le nostre richieste sono chiare ed è possibile agire da subito!


Su questo e tanti altri problemi abbiamo cominciato a confrontarci e attivarci, stilando una lista di richieste. Le puoi leggere nel comunicato di occupazione della Sapienza al QR code nel post. Leggiamole, aggiungiamone altre, discutiamone insieme all’assemblea d’ateneo! Da lì vogliamo partire per organizzarci praticamente in ogni polo, in ogni residenza, in ogni mensa, in ogni corso di studi.


Ci vediamo lunedì 9 novembre alle 11.30 nell’Aula Magna del Polo Carmignani, pranziamo insieme!

Le piazze gremite in tutta Italia hanno detto una cosa molto chiara: noi la guerra non la paghiamo.


Investire sulla guerra è una scelta politica, non solo di questo governo ma di tutta l’oligarchia globale. La guerra non è solo un’ipotesi futura, la guerra occupa già il nostro presente: la paghiamo con il rincaro dei prezzi al supermercato, sui trasporti, sul carburante, sulle bollette. La paghiamo quando il nostro diritto allo studio viene eroso di giorno in giorno, e quando le nostre università, spolpate di fondi e definanziate, devono convertire la propria ricerca agli interessi delle aziende e dell’industria bellica.


Le tante voci alzatesi in corteo oggi nella nostra città si sono unite nella decisione di occupare il palazzo della Sapienza, sede storica dell’università di Pisa, sempre meno a disposizione dellə studentə e sempre più rifunzionalizzata per essere vetrina dell’istituzione. La Sapienza, però, è anche il luogo dove si sono prodotte nel 1967 le

Tesi

, documento programmatico del movimento studentesco che avrebbe trasformato l’università negli anni successivi. Nelle

Tesi

della

Sapienza

dellə studentə in lotta di sessant’anni fa si legge che “l’università appartiene alla base universitaria”. Siamo qui oggi per gridarlo di nuovo a gran voce.


L’università è di chi ci studia e di chi ci lavora. Chiediamo condizioni dignitose per chi le nostre università le tiene aperte, le pulisce e le vive. Vogliamo ribellarci al futuro che ci viene prospettato fatto di precarietà e di saperi svenduti alla guerra e alla devastazione del territorio. Università e conoscenza sono beni pubblici, di cui dobbiamo prenderci cura. L’università deve essere un luogo accessibile a tuttə, che rispetti il nostro tempo e i nostri bisogni, in cui crescere insieme, costruire un futuro collettivo, dove custodire i saperi e metterli a disposizione di un territorio da tutelare.


Immaginiamo un’università che non sia un’autostrada da percorrere per la propria carriera, ma una piazza dove condividere il nostro desiderio di conoscenza e di trasformazione. In tutto il mondo le persone riempiono le strade e dalle università ai porti tutto si può bloccare: l’occupazione della Sapienza è solo una prima pietra lanciata nella nostra città nella nuova ondata di rabbia e desiderio di riscatto che sta animando tutto il Mediterraneo.

author: webdev@democracynow.org (Democracy Now!)
title: First Gen Z Congresswoman: DSA's Melat Kiros on Corruption, Medicare for All & Israel
content:
The Democratic Socialists of America made major gains in this year’s U.S. midterms, electing not just the largest-ever socialist bloc to Congress, but also winning dozens of races at the state, county and municipal levels.

Democracy Now!

 spoke with Congressmember-elect Melat Kiros on election night following her victory in Denver, Colorado. She identified Medicare for All as her top priority and said progressives must lay the groundwork “so that in ’29, when we have the House, the Senate and the White House, we can sign it into law on day one.”


Kiros is a 29-year-old Ethiopian immigrant and lawyer. In 2023, Kiros wrote an open letter about the danger of conflating antisemitism and criticism of Israel, for which she was fired by her law firm. She won a major upset in the Democratic primary earlier this year against longtime incumbent Congressmember Diana DeGette.

author: Unknown
title: Vademecum di resistenza legale. Sanzioni amministrative pecuniarie e iter giudiziario
content:
Le sanzioni amministrative sono uno strumento per colpire il dissenso. I decreti sicurezza del governo Meloni hanno rafforzato un impianto normativo che corrode i diritti d’espressione e a manifestare, sanciti dall’artt.17 e 21 della Costituzione.


Riprendiamo da Torino per Gaza


Manifestare diventa sempre più una “concessione” o un “permesso” delle Autorità, spesso limitato da prescrizioni. Sottoponendo chi manifesta a un rischio economico permanente, mentre economia di guerra e carovita, intrecciate alla situazione geopolitica e alla crisi ecoclimatica ci asfissiano, si produce un effetto intimidatorio aggravando la minaccia della repressione economica.

In questo quadro, il D.L. 23/2026, convertito dalla L. 54/2026 ha modificato l’art.18 del TULPS (prevede che le manifestazioni in luogo pubblico siano preventivamente – almeno tre giorni prima – comunicate alla Questura), intervenendo in modo significativo sul sistema sanzionatorio delle manifestazioni pubbliche. La violazione dell’obbligo di preavviso è stata depenalizzata, cioè trasformata da reato in illecito amministrativo, punito con una sanzione pecuniaria. Lo stesso è avvenuto per la violazione dei divieti e delle prescrizioni del Questore, e sono state introdotte nuove sanzioni anche per altre condotte tenute durante le manifestazioni. Le sanzioni arrivano fino a 12.000 euro, senza possibilità di pagamento in misura ridotta, e aumentano per chi accumula più violazioni.

Quest’evoluzione è parte della rappresaglia governativa per il “Blocchiamo tutto”, le proteste sindacali e degli attivisti per la giustizia climatica. La mobilitazione dal basso ha dimostrato i limiti di questi tentativi di imbrigliare e criminalizzare la legittima resistenza popolare. La stessa repressione con cui il governo risponde altro non è che il risultato dell’efficacia di quelle mobilitazioni e pratiche.


La difesa legale e l’iniziativa politica possono procedere insieme e rafforzarsi a vicenda. Questo è il modo concreto per ostacolare l’applicazione dei decreti sicurezza e organizzarsi collettivamente per non pagare alcuna sanzione e spuntare una delle principali armi della repressione.

Dobbiamo organizzarci per resistere agli attacchi, trasformando ogni tentativo di colpirci in un’occasione di solidarietà e di rilancio della mobilitazione. Dove ci vogliono isolati e soli noi reagiamo collettivamente.

Bando all’improvvisazione: dobbiamo dotarci di strumenti per affrontare ogni singolo attacco e trasformarlo in un terreno di crescita e avanzamento delle nostre lotte. Pertanto, abbiamo predisposto un Vademecum su come affrontare queste sanzioni.


Il Vademecum è stato redatto assieme a legali che in Italia si stanno organizzando per affrontare la difesa delle persone e dei movimenti colpiti.


Oltre al mancato preavviso, sono sanzionate anche la violazione dei divieti e delle prescrizioni del Questore, la presa di parola nelle riunioni non preavvisate, il mancato rispetto del percorso, la turbativa e la promozione della riunione online o in gruppi chiusi. Per chi accumula più violazioni le sanzioni aumentano da un terzo alla metà.

Se ricevi una sanzione amministrativa per art.18 TULPS come modificato dall’art. 9 del D.L. 23/2026, convertito dalla L. 54/2026, ti consigliamo di NON PAGARE ALCUNA SANZIONE nell’immediato, di rivolgerti alle reti solidali e a un legale di tua fiducia per predisporre il ricorso. Ecco in breve come si procede


⇩

VERBALE DI ACCERTAMENTO E CONTESTAZIONE

Redatto dall’organo accertatore (Questura/DIGOS, Carabinieri…), descrive il fatto imputato e le violazioni contestate e avvisa che la sanzione (da 1.000 a 10.000 €, che passano da 1.000 a 12.000 € per la violazione di divieti e prescrizioni – Sul verbale la multa è indicata come minimi e massimi ma non è quantificata) verrà successivamente quantificata dal Prefetto con un’ordinanza-ingiunzione.


Tale verbale deve arrivare entro 90 giorni dall’accertamento, indicando in 30 giorni la possibilità di effettuare scritti difensivi presso il Prefetto. È possibile, secondo valutazioni proprie e confrontandosi con i propri legali, presentare scritti difensivi in questa fase e chiedere di essere ascoltati personalmente dal Prefetto (il verbale non si impugna davanti al giudice!).

Se invece il verbale arriva oltre il termine, la sanzione si estingue (conserva la busta e la data di notifica!).

title: Cremona: sabato 7 novembre manifestazione “Adèss Baasta” contro carovita e riarmo
content:
Studenti e lavoratori pronti a scendere in piazza a Cremona contro il carovita e il riarmo: sabato 7 novembre si terrà infatti una manifestazione con lo slogan Adèss Baasta, che mira a riunire studenti, lavoratori, giovani e associazioni. Il ritrovo è fissato alle 14 nel parcheggio dell’ex Foro Boario, in via Mantova. La partenza del corteo è prevista per le 15.


Da Radio Onda d’Urto


Al centro della mobilitazione ci sono soprattutto il rincaro dei carburanti, l’aumento dei prezzi dei beni di consumo e il peso delle bollette. Nel testo che accompagna la locandina, gli organizzatori scrivono: “Il diesel ha superato i 2 euro al litro, la spesa costa di più ogni giorno, gli stipendi non bastano e l’inverno ci aspetta con bollette salatissime”. La protesta si rivolge anche alle scelte del Governo in materia di spesa pubblica e politica internazionale. Gli organizzatori contestano “i finanziamenti destinati agli armamenti e chiedono maggiori risorse per scuola, sanità, edilizia popolare e contrasto al carovita”. Tra le richieste indicate nel volantino c’è anche quella di “tassare gli extraprofitti” degli speculatori.


La mobilitazione viene presentata dagli organizzatori come parte di un più ampio clima di protesta nazionale, richiamando anche le giornate di sciopero generale del 30 ottobre e del 20 novembre e le iniziative di protesta di autotrasportatori, agricoltori, studenti e movimenti.

Ad organizzare la manifestazione il collettivo studentesco “Corrente Z” col supporto di associazioni come Arci, Circolo Arcipelago, Arci Persichello, Fiom e sindacati di base.


La presentazione con Silvia dell’Arci Persichello di Cremona

title: «La visita del Papa debe poner en evidencia la crisis que el Gobierno quiere tapar»
content:
El secretario general de ATE Nacional, Rodolfo Aguiar, reclamó que la próxima visita del papa León XIV a la Argentina no quede reducida a una agenda protocolar y que sirva para visibilizar las consecuencias sociales de las políticas económicas del gobierno de Javier Milei. «Milei no quiere paz. Lo quiere al Papa como escudo. Quiere lavarse las manos con él. Lo quiere utilizar para tapar el sufrimiento del pueblo argentino», sostuvo el dirigente, quien pidió que el Pontífice «mire más allá del protocolo», que «muestre todo lo que el Gobierno quiere tapar» y sea «la voz de los argentinos que están sufriendo». León XIV llegará este domingo 8 de noviembre y permanecerá en el país hasta el miércoles 11. Durante su estadía visitará Buenos Aires, Claypole, Córdoba y Luján, tendrá encuentros con representantes del mundo del trabajo, autoridades políticas, dirigentes religiosos y jóvenes, y celebrará misas multitudinarias. Mientras el Gobierno prepara un importante operativo institucional, de seguridad y transporte, organizaciones sindicales y movimientos sociales buscarán poner en agenda la pobreza, la pérdida de empleo, el endeudamiento familiar y el deterioro de las condiciones de vida.

Por ANRed.


El secretario general de la Asociación Trabajadores del Estado (ATE) Nacional,

Rodolfo Aguiar

, reclamó que

la próxima visita del papa León XIV a la Argentina sirva para visibilizar las consecuencias sociales y económicas de las políticas del gobierno de Javier Milei

. «Al Papa

le quieren mostrar una Argentina maquillada, y su visita tiene que mostrar la crisis que estamos atravesando

», sostuvo el dirigente, quien pidió al Pontífice que «mire más allá del protocolo» y sea «la voz de los argentinos que están sufriendo».


Aguiar también cuestionó el mensaje que Milei publicó en sus redes sociales, en el que pidió que la visita papal «fortalezca la fe, renueve la esperanza y lleve un mensaje de paz a todos los argentinos». «

¿De verdad el Presidente le pidió a León XIV traiga paz al pueblo argentino? No puede haber paz sin justicia social. No puede haber paz sin trabajo. No puede haber paz sin paz. Milei no quiere paz. Lo quiere al Papa como escudo. Quiere lavarse las manos con él. Lo quiere utilizar para tapar el sufrimiento del pueblo argentino

», afirmó. El dirigente reclamó que

la Iglesia ponga en evidencia «la realidad de jubilados que no pueden comprar sus remedios, de los pibes que se van a dormir sin comer» y sostuvo que «ningún ajuste puede cerrar con los trabajadores afuera»

.


Imagen: prensa ATE Nacional.


El planteo no es aislado:

distintos sectores sociales, sindicales y empresariales buscan que la visita tenga una agenda vinculada con la crisis económica y social

.


En septiembre,

Alejandro «Peluca» Gramajo

, secretario general de la

Unión de Trabajadores y Trabajadoras de la Economía Popular (UTEP)

, entregó personalmente a León XIV un

informe de 72 páginas sobre la situación argentina

. El documento aborda la

pérdida del poder adquisitivo, el endeudamiento de las familias, los problemas de salud mental, la situación de los jubilados y trabajadores, los discursos de odio y la criminalización de la protesta

. A fines de octubre, una delegación del Vaticano participó también de un encuentro regional organizado por la UTEP en La Matanza, destinado a acercar las preocupaciones de los movimientos populares al Pontífice.


La CGT, empresarios y movimientos sociales también trabajan en un documento conjunto

 sobre la situación económica nacional para presentarlo durante el encuentro con el mundo del trabajo en la UCA. Entre quienes impulsan esa iniciativa aparecen

Jorge Sola

, dirigente de la CGT, y

Osvaldo Cornide

, expresidente de la Confederación Argentina de la Mediana Empresa (CAME). La propuesta busca instalar un diagnóstico sobre la pérdida de empleo, el deterioro de los ingresos y las dificultades que atraviesan las pequeñas y medianas empresas. Desde la conducción sindical plantearon la posibilidad de utilizar la reunión para impulsar un espacio de diálogo entre trabajadores y empresarios.


En paralelo,

 la Iglesia busca evitar que la visita sea utilizada para señalamientos políticos, aunque distintos referentes eclesiásticos reconocen su preocupación por el impacto del ajuste sobre los sectores más vulnerables

.


La expectativa de que León XIV se refiera a la pobreza, el trabajo, las desigualdades y la justicia social también se apoya en sus propias intervenciones anteriores …

title: Journalist Haşim Abak detained in Mardin
content:
Kurdish journalist Haşim Abak, a reporter for the Mezopotamya News Agency (MA), was detained on Tuesday night in the district of Nusaybin in Mardin province. Abak was traveling in a vehicle when he was stopped by police.


Necla Özgezer and a 16-year-old identified by the initials H. T. were also taken into custody alongside him. On Wednesday morning, the three were transferred to the Mardin Police Headquarters and handed over to the Counterterrorism Department (TEM).


They are expected to be questioned later in the day. No information has yet been provided regarding the reasons for their detention.

title: Özdal: Ruling elites openly robbed large sections of society
content:
The economic and political repercussions of the financial developments that erupted in Turkey in September and became known publicly as the "fund crisis" continue to be debated. Allegations have emerged that numerous individuals, including figures affiliated with the Justice and Development Party (AKP), obtained illicit profits through investment funds.


Some figures released in connection with the crisis suggest that losses may have reached as much as 2.7 trillion Turkish liras. Investigations involving the names of AKP figures and state officials have intensified public debate, while criticism of the government's handling of the crisis has also grown. President Tayyip Erdoğan's latest remarks on the fund crisis have been interpreted as an indication of growing discontent over the developments even among AKP supporters.


Journalist Hakkı Özdal spoke to ANF about the causes of the fund crisis, the relationship between political authorities and financial circles, the role of international capital and the crisis's potential impact on society.


'The bubble economists and journalists had warned about has burst'


Hakkı Özdal said that numerous warnings had previously been issued about the developments known as the fund crisis. He emphasized that the crisis had not emerged suddenly, but was the result of a financial system that had operated for years before being pushed into crisis by international intervention. Özdal added that international financial institutions had intensified their warnings to Turkish authorities and that the crisis erupted following regulations introduced by the Capital Markets Board (SPK) concerning money market funds and hedge funds.


Özdal said: "The chain of events described as the fund crisis actually emerged when a form of fraud that had been going on for years, and about which certain journalists and financial market commentators had long been issuing warnings, was triggered by international intervention and then inevitably exploded. As you know, international financial institutions began intensifying their warnings to Turkish authorities at the beginning of the summer. The Capital Markets Board subsequently introduced significant restrictions and tighter regulations on money market funds and hedge funds, which came into effect on 28 August. The fund crisis then struck like a tsunami. A bubble that international financial institutions, as well as economists and even journalists in our country, had already identified finally burst."


'Ruling elites openly robbed large sections of society'


Özdal argued that the high returns generated through money market funds primarily benefited political and economic elites. However, he noted that small savers, wage earners, industrialists and tradespeople had also turned to these funds in an effort to protect their savings. Özdal underlined that persistently high inflation over many years had driven broad sections of society toward alternative investment instruments, adding that mass participation in these funds had paved the way for large-scale financial fraud.


Özdal said: "The beneficiaries of the massive profiteering through high returns on money market funds were the elites of political and economic power. This is now plainly evident. However, in our country, which has been struggling with high inflation for nearly eight years, wage earners in particular turned to these funds to protect their modest savings from the devastating effects of inflation. It also appears that small and medium-sized industrialists and traders, as well as a very large number of small business owners, who have been unable to access credit and affordable financing amid high inflation and high interest rates, invested money in these funds even to address their short-term financing needs. These massive financial fraud schemes were made possible precisely by this widespread participation. In a sense, the ruling elites openly robbed a very large section of society. Yes, there is absolutely nothing wrong with calling it what it was: robbery."


'Those running the regime had no choice but to intervene'


Özdal said that the political leadership had been forced to intervene after the crisis erupted, warning that its consequences would not be confined to financial markets but could also affect production, trade and employment. Özdal pointed to estimates suggesting that the losses exceeded $100 billion, arguing that the crisis would have social and political consequences as well …

title: Mehtap Sakinci: Femicide is political
content:
Lawyer Mehtap Sakinci, one of the founders of the 10 October Peace Association, spoke to ANF about peace, justice and the women's struggle on the 11th anniversary of the 10 October Ankara Train Station Massacre.


Sakinci said that femicide was political and criticized Turkey's withdrawal from the Istanbul Convention and the shortcomings in the implementation of Law No. 6284. She stressed that women played an important role in building peace and called on women to stand together and strengthen their struggle ahead of 25 November, the International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women.


 


'

Women are an important part of the struggle for peace'


Mehtap Sakinci lost her husband, lawyer Uygar Coşgun, in the Ankara Train Station Massacre carried out by the Islamic State of Iraq and Syria (ISIS) on 10 October 2015. She continues to honor the memory of those who lost their lives at the peace rally 11 years ago and to express their longing for peace on every platform.


Sakinci expressed her enthusiasm about attending the conference, where women's role in building peace was being discussed and said: "I was genuinely excited to take part in this event, where women stand together and the importance of women's role in building peace is truly emphasized."


Sakinci said that women coming together reminded them of their collective strength in social struggles. She continued: "By reminding ourselves that being a woman and the strength women demonstrate in this country, in this world and under the circumstances we live in should never be underestimated, we are showing one another just how important a role women play in the struggles for peace, democracy and labor rights in this country."


'Courtrooms stand strong through the power of women'


Mehtap Sakinci said that she had served as president of the 10 October Peace Association for nearly 10 years before handing over the position to her colleagues a year ago. She spoke about the association's establishment and the struggle for justice carried out by women who lost loved ones in the massacre.


Sakinci said that women's voices and solidarity had played a decisive role in the legal struggle following the massacre and added: "I handed over responsibility for the process to my colleagues a year ago. But as a woman, as someone who lost her husband and as a woman who has paid a price in this country, I remain a living witness to just how difficult it is for a woman to carry this struggle forward.


When we established the association as families of those who lost their lives, I embarked on this journey as a woman who had lost her husband, alongside fathers who had lost their children. Throughout this process, I have seen how deeply women's voices, strength, cries and tears have resonated, particularly those of mothers who lost their children.


Today, as the proceedings concerning the 10 October massacre continue, it is once again the strength of women that sustains the courtrooms. They echo with the voices of my fellow women lawyers."


'I have no doubt that peace will come through women'


Mehtap Sakinci emphasized the responsibilities women assumed in building peace and the power of solidarity, stressing that women coming together would strengthen the struggle for peace.


Sakinci said: "I believe it is important to emphasize this: If peace is to come to this country, and if people are to take responsibility for building that peace, I have absolutely no doubt that women will be the ones to make it happen.


Perhaps we also need to remind ourselves of something on platforms like this: People heal one another's pain, and women are a homeland for one another. Women who have suffered, who have paid a price and who have truly stood at the forefront of the struggle for rights in this country need other women beside them. I believe that only when women come together can we bring peace with a louder and stronger voice."


'Turkey withdrew from the Istanbul Convention, and Law No. 6284 remains insufficient'


As 25 November approaches, Mehtap Sakinci recalled Turkey's withdrawal from the Istanbul Convention and criticized the inadequacy of legal provisions and practices intended to protect women from violence.

title: 12th edition of Serçavan Kurdish Film Days opens in Vienna
content:
The Serçavan Kurdish Film Days, which have been held at different intervals in Vienna since 1999, opened for the 12th time this year.


The festival, taking place at Votivkino, is organised in cooperation with the Assembly of the Kurdish Community in Austria (FEYKOM), the Union of Kurdish Students (YXK), and partner organisations.


The five-day festival, running from 4 to 8 November, features a programme of feature films, documentaries and short films. Addressing Kurdish history, culture, identity, experiences of migration and contemporary social realities, the films present audiences with a variety of perspectives and narratives.


 


The festival opened with the documentary

To My Sisters

, which tells the stories of Kurdish women fighters and their struggle for freedom. Following the screening, the director took part in an online question-and-answer session and responded to questions from the audience.


Kurds must tell their own stories


Delivering the opening speech, Saya Ahmad, Head of the Alsergrund District, said the festival was important in making the history, culture and lives of the Kurdish community more visible.


Stressing that Serçavan was about more than simply screening films, Saya Ahmad said the festival created a shared space where people could come together, engage in discussions and encounter different perspectives. Ahmad highlighted the importance of representing Kurdish identity, language and culture in the public sphere.


Gule C., from the festival's organising committee, emphasised that Kurdish cinema was directly connected to stories, identities, languages and collective social memory.


Noting that Kurdish lives are often told through the voices of others, Gule C. stressed the importance of the right of Kurds to tell their own stories. She said Kurdish cinema brings a range of experiences to the screen from its own perspective, including love, loss, happiness, pain, resistance, migration and everyday life.


Kurdish women continue their struggle


Speaking at the festival's opening, Green Party MP and lawyer Berivan Aslan said Kurdish filmmakers face repression both in Kurdistan and in Europe.


Drawing attention to the obstacles preventing Kurdish films from being screened in Turkey, Berivan Aslan spoke about the resistance of Kurdish women who fought against ISIS, referring to the opening documentary,

To My Sisters

.


Emphasising that Kurdish women struggle not only during particular periods but throughout every aspect of their lives, Berivan Aslan highlighted the ongoing nature of women's fight for freedom.


Berivan Aslan also mentioned Selahattin Demirtaş and Figen Yüksekdağ, who remain imprisoned in Turkey, criticising their continued detention despite European Court of Human Rights (ECHR) rulings calling for their release. She called on Europe to assume greater responsibility for securing the freedom of political prisoners.


Following the opening speeches, musician Özlem Bulut performed a selection of kilam and songs for the audience. A fundraising campaign is also being held as part of the festival to support new projects in Kurdish cinema.


On the festival's second day, Azad Altay's documentary

The Memory of Sur

 (Bîra Sûrê) will examine the destruction of Amed's historic Sur district. Hemo, which explores everyday life and the process of social construction in Rojava, and Kazım Öz's political satire

Oy'una Geldik

 will also be screened.


On Friday, the films

Xezîne

,

Rojava Rûmeta Meye

,

Habā,

 which address violence against women, and

Arzela from Amed

, which focuses on the struggle for democracy, will be screened. The day's final screening will be

Heval Birako,

 which tells the story of two Yazidi siblings escaping captivity under ISIS.


Saturday's programme will feature the short film

Dengê Kilîtan – Voices and Locks

,

The Manuscript

,

Yerli Yurtsu

z (Rootless Resident), which explores Armenian identity and the search for one's roots, and

Dimilî: Ewro Tirkî Yasax A

, which focuses on preserving the Dimilî language. Following the screenings, there will be a discussion with filmmaker, video journalist and photographer Özgür Rayzan.


At the festival's closing,

Mugarik Gabe – No Borders

, directed by Boris Guevara, will explore the cultural and musical connections between the Basque Country and Kurdistan. The film features internationally known actress Itziar Ituño and Kurdish singer Mizgin Tahir among others.

title: 'Voce Arcaica' Festival in memory of Nagihan Akarsel to take place in Rome on 7 November
content:
The 'Voce Arcaica' (Ancient Voice) Art and Culture Festival, organised annually in Italy by the Jineolojî Academy, is held in memory of Nagihan Akarsel, a member of the Jineolojî Research Centre, writer and journalist who was assassinated in an armed attack outside her home in Sulaymaniyah (Silêmanî) on 4 October 2022.


The festival will take place on 7 November at the Teatro Biblioteca Quarticciolo in Rome, and aims to bring women together through art, culture and collective creation.


In an

article

, the Jineolojî Academy wrote that the festival was organised to continue the work of Nagihan Akarsel, who made significant contributions to Jineolojî, women's journalism and research on women, and to keep her ideas alive through art.


The article emphasised that art is not merely a form of expression, but also a means of passing on women's collective memory, resistance and experiences of struggle.


Four stops on the festival's journey


As part of this year's third edition, events have been held throughout the year in Rome, Reggio Calabria, Turin, Bologna and the Dutch town of Haelen. At these gatherings, the book

Voce Arcaica

 (Ancient Voice), a collection of 16 articles by Nagihan Akarsel, was introduced. Participants also took part in a collective embroidery project featuring a portrait of Nagihan Akarsel.


Through workshops, readings and artistic events held in different cities, women came together to discuss Nagihan Akarsel's ideas and Jineolojî. The collective embroidery project continued throughout the festival's various stops, with women from different communities contributing to the work.


During these gatherings, participants shared ideas, emotions, dreams and memories. The portrait of Nagihan Akarsel is scheduled to be exhibited at the Rome gathering on 7 November.


Theatre, music and dance


The programme on 7 November will begin with a workshop in the Quarticciolo neighbourhood, running from 10 am to 1 pm. Led by Barbara Criscimanno from Palermo and the Trizzi Ri Donna collective, the workshop will explore the choral, dance and rhythmic traditions of southern Italy. The workshop will be free of charge and open to women and people of diverse identities.


The festival's evening programme will begin at 8.30 pm on the stage of Teatro Biblioteca Quarticciolo. Performers will include Rachele Andrioli & Coro a Coro, Deniz Deman, the European Jineolojî Choir and Controchiave Teatro. The event will feature theatre, music and dance performances, conveying women's stories of struggle and resistance through art.


The festival is being organised in collaboration with the Jineolojî Academy, alongside women's organisations and solidarity networks including Rete Jin, Rete Donneche Tessono il Futuro, Oltre and Non Una di Meno Roma. The event forms part of wider initiatives aimed at bringing women together through art and culture ahead of 25 November, the International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women.

title: [Nach dem erfolgreichen Migra-Streik in Magdeburg] Halle ohne uns? – Migra-Streik am 5. November 2026 mit Geschäftsschließungen und Kundgebung
content:
„

Nach dem erfolgreichen

Migra-Streik in Magdeburg im August

 organisieren sich nun auch Menschen mit Migrationsgeschichte in Halle (Saale). Unter dem Motto „Halle ohne uns?“ ruft die Bürgerinitiative MigraStark am 5. November 2026 zu einem migrantischen Aktionstag auf. Von 10 bis 16 Uhr sind Geschäftsschließungen geplant, von 14 bis 16 Uhr findet eine Kundgebung auf dem Marktplatz in Halle statt. MigraStark stellt dabei den Protest gegen Rassismus und Ausgrenzung sowie für Solidarität und Gleichberechtigung in den Mittelpunkt. Der Flüchtlingsrat Sachsen-Anhalt e.V. unterstützt diese selbstorganisierte Initiative ausdrücklich. Nach der Wahl ist die Verunsicherung nicht verschwunden – im Gegenteil

…“

Pressemitteilung vom 26. Oktober 2026 beim Flüchtlingsrat Sachsen-Anhalt


 – siehe mehr daraus und weitere Infos zum selbstorganisierten Aktionstag gegen Rassismus und Ausgrenzung:


Achtung: Die Kundgebung von 14 bis 16 Uhr nicht auf dem Marktplatz in Halle, sondern am Steintor!


Halle ohne uns? – Migra-Streik am 5. November in Halle


Selbstorganisierter Aktionstag gegen Rassismus und Ausgrenzung – Geschäftsschließungen von 10 bis 16 Uhr – Kundgebung von 14 bis 16 Uhr auf dem Marktplatz in Halle. Siehe Initiative „MigraStark“ (leider nur)

https://www.instagram.com/migrastark/

 


Weiter aus der

Pressemitteilung vom 26. Oktober 2026 beim Flüchtlingsrat Sachsen-Anhalt


: „…

Bei der Landtagswahl am 6. September wurde die AfD stärkste Kraft in Sachsen-Anhalt. Ihr Landesverband wird als gesichert rechtsextremistisch eingestuft. Ihr Spitzenkandidat hat angekündigt, sich im Dezember zum Ministerpräsidenten wählen lassen zu wollen. Wie die Regierungsbildung ausgeht, ist weiterhin offen. Für viele Menschen mit Flucht- und Migrationsgeschichte ist diese Entwicklung keine abstrakte parteipolitische Frage. Sie erleben eine zunehmende Unsicherheit darüber, welche Zukunft sie und ihre Familien in Sachsen-Anhalt haben, ob ihre Zugehörigkeit weiterhin selbstverständlich sein wird und welche politische Macht in einer neuen Landesregierung entstehen könnte.


Der Flüchtlingsrat erklärt dazu: „Menschenwürde hat keine Legislaturperiode. Grund- und Menschenrechte gelten jederzeit – und für alle. Ihr Schutz muss von jeder Regierung sichergestellt werden. Hierfür setzt der Aktionstag in Halle ein deutliches Zeichen.“


Magdeburg hat gezeigt, was Selbstorganisation bewirken kann


Denn gerade jetzt ist es wichtig, dass Betroffene nicht nur Gegenstand politischer Debatten bleiben, sondern selbst sprechen, sich selbst organisieren und ihre Rechte sichtbar einfordern. Die Aktion erreichte weit über Sachsen-Anhalt hinaus öffentliche Aufmerksamkeit. Entscheidend war dabei nicht allein die Zahl geschlossener Geschäfte. Entscheidend war, dass Menschen selbst ihre Stimme erhoben, einander unterstützten und deutlich machten: Wir lassen uns nicht gegeneinander ausspielen.


Halle knüpft nun mit einer eigenen, selbstorganisierten Initiative daran an.

author: Unknown
title: Carcere e domiciliari per la manifestazione del 31 gennaio a Torino
content:
Questa mattina la Questura di Torino ha eseguito diverse misure cautelari inerenti il filone di indagini sulla manifestazione nazionale contro lo sgombero del centro sociale Askatasuna di Torino, del 31 gennaio 2026.


All’alba diversi compagni e compagne sono stati prelevati dalle loro abitazioni dalla Digos per eseguire le misure cautelari decise dal Giudice per le indagini preliminari.

Due compagni sono stati portati in carcere, sette agli arresti domiciliari, sei si vedono applicato il divieto di dimora a Torino con obbligo di firma quotidiana e un ulteriore obbligo di firma quotidiana.


Tutto questo avviene dopo che, una decina di giorni fa, la prima fase dell’operazione giudiziaria aveva convocato una ventina di persone davanti al Giudice per gli interrogatori di “garanzia”.


Compagni e compagne da diverse città del paese sono stati colpiti da questa inchiesta con accuse talvolta anche molto gravi come il

“tentato omicidio”

, nell’intento di criminalizzare poche persone per un corteo di più di 50 mila persone che erano scese in piazza per protestare contro la stretta repressiva del governo Meloni e la “punizione” che questo aveva voluto infliggere alla città di Torino, colpendo uno dei simboli delle lotte cittadine.

Il Gip avvalla quasi in toto le richieste della Procura torinese disponendo misure che colpiscono in maniera pesante le persone inquisite.

 Le accuse spaziano dalla resistenza a pubblico ufficiale e danneggiamento fino al tentato omicidio e la rapina. I reati smisurati che vengono contestati sono l’immagine plastica di come la le istituzioni vogliano trasformare il dissenso e il conflitto sociale in un problema di ordine pubblico. Viene sposata una lettura della manifestazione che non tiene conto della spontaneità della rabbia di quella giornata e cerca di rinchiuderla tutta all’interno del solito teorema di “un’oscura premeditazione” , arrivando a disporre i domiciliari anche per chi è accusato solo di essere stato presente vicino o sopra il furgone del corteo.


Le lotte che hanno seguito lo sgombero di Askatasuna si sono inserite in un contesto più ampio di opposizione al governo e di rifiuto del genocidio contro il popolo palestinese, di cui è tutt’ora complice. In questi mesi assistiamo ad una grande sollevazione sociale contro il carovita di guerra e i suoi responsabili, gli arresti di oggi rientrano nella strategia del manganello adottata dal Governo per punire chi protesta.

 Oggi però non sarà solo il primo passo concreto di una ingiusta e criminale operazione repressiva, ma l’inizio di un’iniziativa di solidarietà che dovrà saper sostenere chi è stato colpito nelle spese legali che dovrà affrontare e per non lasciarli soli.

Il 31 gennaio c’eravamo tutti e tutte! Que viva Askatasuna!

author: Trojka
title: Ten pociąg już odjechał. Lewica w konflikcie o TK. (komentarz)
content:
Kolejne starcie w walce o polityczną kontrolę nad Trybunałem Konstytucyjnym wprawia w wyraźne zakłopotanie lewicowy komentariat.


Od piątkowego wieczora, gdy pod ochroną policji delegaci obecnej władzy opanowali budynek TK lewicowe blogi zdominował przekaż “nie moje małpy, nie mój cyrk”, tezy o zastępczym konflikcie wywołanym przez cichy sojusz władzy i prawicowej opozycji, ubolewanie, że społeczne emocje nie skupiają się na “prawdziwych problemach.”


Jest zrozumiałe, że problem bezprawnych działań rządu czy wykorzystania zinstytucjonalizowanej przemocy by zmienić skład instytucji, powołanej do kontroli poczynań władzy metodą faktów dokonanych może być niekomfortowy dla zwolenników państwowego socjalizmu, widzących w zdobyciu władzy politycznej przez lewicę drogę do realizacji ideałów wolności i sprawiedliwości. W końcu to zagrożenie oligarchizacją i samoistnym przekształceniem każdej władzy w dyktaturę są jednymi z najważniejszych argumentów w krytyce etatyzmu, nie tylko tej anarchistycznej. Milczenie lewicy w chwili, gdy zagrożenie to staje się realne nie jest dowodem jej intelektualnej wyższości, lecz własnej niemocy i braku przekonujących odpowiedzi na pytania, stawiane przez rozwój politycznej sytuacji.


Anarchizm i socjalizm to nie “prawie to samo”

. Od czasów sporu Bakunina z Marksem o konieczność powołania “państwa socjalistycznego” jako etapu budowy bez państwowego społeczeństwa anarchiści rozwijają własną krytykę hierarchicznej władzy, a kolejne, historyczne doświadczenia potwierdzają słuszność jej założeń. Z anarchistycznego punktu widzenia to, czego jesteśmy świadkami to po prostu kolejny przykład tego, jak władza ustanowiona dzięki społecznym protestom i społecznej mobilizacji w krótkim czasie zmienia się w oligarchię, zmierzającą do przejęcia wszelkich instytucji mogących ograniczać jej kompetencje i gwarantować choćby niewielki zakres kontroli jej poczynań aż do momentu, gdy jedynym ograniczeniem uprawnień rządu staje się jego własna wyobraźnia. Historycznie proces ten był udziałem wszystkich “socjalistycznych demokracji” jakie próbowano ustanowić w różnych okresach i różnych punktach świata. Dziś, na naszych oczach, dotyka zaś demokracji liberalnych – udowadniając że zasada rządów prawa, demokratyczny konsensus czy konstytucyjne bezpieczniki nie są w stanie powstrzymać rządu, zdeterminowanego by poszerzyć własne kompetencje poza te zapisane w prawie. Liberalne państwo i jego demokratyczne instytucje nie jest w stanie powstrzymać samego siebie przed demontażem liberalnego porządku, gdy staje on na drodze realizacji “sprawczości” władzy. Może to zrobić tylko społeczeństwo, o ile jest zorganizowane, świadome swoich interesów i zdeterminowane do działania.


To fakt, że realistyczny zakres politycznych wyborów sprowadza się dziś do wyboru między dżumą a cholerą. Bez względu na to, czy w obecnym konflikcie zwycięży “uśmiechnięta dyktatura” czy “nowy faszyzm” – nie przybliży to w żaden sposób realizacji anarchistycznych ideałów. Wciąż jednak w naszym interesie jest, by ktokolwiek wygra, nie był dość silny by rządzić bez stałego zabiegania o społeczne poparcie. By w sporze z władzą, ktokolwiek będzie ją sprawować, sprawczość była po stronie społeczeństwa. Nawet pozorowane, sprokurowane na potrzeby politycznego spektaklu konfrontacje są realne o tyle, o ile generują realne społeczne napięcia i definiują nowe linie społecznych podziałów. Stać z boku i krytykować je z wyżyn własnej, intelektualnej refleksji to przegrać walkę o społeczeństwo na starcie – to jak stać na peronie i czekać aż nadjedzie wagon z napisem “uprawniony, socjalny konflikt społeczny” w czasie, gdy pociąg społecznych emocji znika już za horyzontem.

content:

Bom dia, fim do mundo

Articulação dos Povos Indígenas do Brasil

Ouça agora.

No quadro “Se é pra falar de economia…”, Clara Marinho pede: demarcação já.
